name: AI Upscaler Plugin
overview: AI-Powered Video Upscaling Plugin with Docker Microservice Architecture
description: Video upscaling through an external AI service, with client-side scaling and optional object masking. Backend and model availability depend on the installed image and hardware. HDR processing is limited to single PQ/BT.2020 RGB16 frames; target-hardware validation is required.
changelog: v1.8.3.37: Real-time upscaling now starts for users who are not Jellyfin administrators; the player read its settings through the admin-only plugin configuration and got a 403. Three security fixes: a library file name could run script in the admin dashboard, the library list and the job queue were open to every signed-in user, and the WebGPU AI mode sent the viewer's Jellyfin token to HuggingFace with its model downloads. New Pre-upscaled tab (from tumo07's PR #101). ImageSharp 4.1.3 replaces 3.x, which had open security advisories. In the AI service: AMD runs on ROCm, the NVIDIA and Intel images check at build time that their GPU provider loads, the Vulkan/ncnn path upscales correctly, and the model catalog names each model's licence (SPAN x2, Remacri x4 and CodeFormer are non-commercial upstream and are now marked so). Those parts need the 1.8.3.37 Docker image, which is not published as a release yet. Requires Jellyfin 12.0 or newer. Target-hardware playback, GPU and HDR acceptance remain unverified.
